verdict.rationale: RevenueCat documents one recurring background job: scheduled data exports that deliver app data to cloud storage or email on a user-controlled schedule. That is a real recurring automation, not a one-off action, but it is limited to data delivery. A community feature request for timed hooks, such as trial-expiry reminders, suggests there is no general automation builder. Missing for 10: general-purpose automation or workflow rules, agent-driven background tasks, trigger-action configuration beyond exports, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: RevenueCat delivers your apps' data to a cloud storage provider or to email on a schedule you control.
